subject: Northbridge - Enterprise access orchestration kickoff
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.p@northbridge.io>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Northbridge access orchestration (SSO, SCIM, allowlists)

Hi Aisha / Stephanie —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Per our discussion, this thread will centralize the technical handoff for Northbridge's enterprise access setup (SSO via Okta, SCIM provisioning, IP allowlist for production, and service-account patterns for automation). Goal: have a staged rollout to one product team (canary) in the next 3 weeks, then full org provisioning the week after.

Requests up front from our side:
- SAML metadata (IdP XML) and whether assertions are signed/encrypted
- SCIM API access: token or service account credentials + allowed IPs for callback / provisioning
- Corporate egress IPs for allowlist (we can accept ranges, but need exact prefixes)
- Any org policies that will block service accounts (e.g., blocked non-human logins)

I've attached a short questionnaire (northbridge-sso-questions.xlsx) and our runbook stub (redwood-access-runbook-v1.3.pdf) — please fill out the spreadsheet and drop in the Drive folder (link below) when convenient.

Proposed near-term timeline:
- Day 0 (this week): finalize IdP metadata + SCIM token
- Day 3: test SAML sign-on with canary users + SCIM create/sync
- Day 7: IP allowlist verification against production endpoints
- Day 14: full provisioning + org policy audit

Would appreciate confirmation of owners on your side (IdP, infra, security) and any scheduling constraints.

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Monica — looping in internal leads. Short plan from infra/implementation perspective:

- Owner assignments:
  - Implementation lead (SSO/SCIM): laura_bennett@redwood.com
  - Security & compliance lead: jonas_weber@redwood.com
  - CSM/PM: monica_patel@redwood.com

- Artifacts attached: redwood-access-runbook-v1.3.pdf (implementation checklist), northbridge-sso-questions.xlsx (fields highlighted we need filled).

Immediate asks for Northbridge so we can start the canary tomorrow morning:
1) IdP metadata (XML) + indication whether Okta will sign/encrypt assertions
2) SCIM token (temp) and a sample user payload or CSV mapping (groups->roles)
3) CIDR blocks for your corporate egress so we can prepare the allowlist and test endpoints

Operational notes / constraints we generally run into:
- SCIM: we support bulk provisioning in 100-user batches; if your org expects >10k users we should discuss batching window and rate limits.
- Service accounts: we recommend short-lived API keys surfaced via your vault; otherwise we'll restrict tokens to the service account’s IPs.

Proposed kickoff call: Wed 11/3 09:00 PT (30 min). If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Implementation Lead, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Northbridge access orchestration (SSO, SCIM, allowlists)

Adding the security checklist — please see items below so Northbridge can validate with their SecOps team: 

Mandatory for production enablement:
- SAML: IdP metadata (entityID, singleSignOnService URL, x509 cert). Confirm if Okta will sign assertions and whether they will use SHA-256. If assertions are encrypted we need the decryption cert.
- SCIM: token with admin-scoped provisioning rights. Token scope should allow PATCH/PUT/POST/DELETE for Users and Groups.
- Service accounts: confirm if your org allows long-lived non-human credentials. If not, we will require a short-lived token exchange (recommended).
- IP allowlist: precise CIDR blocks for Redwood egress (we'll also provide our egress list). Please confirm whether you can create a source NAT for multi-region egress.
- Audit logs: retention expectations and whether Redwood must forward logs or if Northbridge will pull via API.

Optional but recommended:
- SCIM group membership mapped to product roles (we need exact attribute names).
- A sample user lifecycle: create -> deactivate -> reassign for automated testing.

If Northbridge has a policy or SOC control that restricts third-party provisioning, flag that now — it will impact rollout timing.

-Jonas
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.p@northbridge.io>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 13:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Northbridge access orchestration (SSO, SCIM, allowlists)

Hi Aisha — quick technical notes from the implementation side so your IdP/DevOps can prepare: 

SCIM specifics we need to confirm:
- Preferred SCIM endpoints: /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups (standard).
- Attribute mapping: we expect externalId, userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work], groups[display], active. If you use custom attributes for role (e.g., extension_role) please indicate the full attribute path.
- Provisioning cadence: we’ll POST in batches of up to 100 users. For near-real-time provisioning we can support incremental PATCHes; confirm expected throughput (users/min).

Service account pattern:
- We prefer a vaulted API key rotated via your CI (recommended cadence 30d). If Northbridge cannot rotate keys, we can accept a scoped token tied to CIDR blocks and a limited expiry (90d).

Testing plan:
1) Create 5 canary users in Okta in a sandbox tenant → verify SAML login to Redwood app (canary project)
2) Use SCIM token to provision same users and validate attributes and group mapping
3) Exercise deprovision path and confirm tokens / sessions are revoked

Can you provide one sample user JSON (or export CSV) and the SCIM base URL? Also please confirm whether Okta will provide a test sandbox for early verification or we should use a staging connector.

Thanks — I’ll draft the implementation checklist into the runbook after we get the details.
Laura
Senior Implementation Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.p@northbridge.io>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: infra@northbridge.io, Mike Reynolds <mike.reynolds@northbridge.io>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 15:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Northbridge access orchestration (SSO, SCIM, allowlists)

Thanks all — quick answers from Northbridge infra/security: 

- IdP: Okta (enterprise). We will provide the IdP metadata XML and confirm assertion signing (we use RSA-SHA256). No encryption of assertions today. Expect an export by EOD.
- SCIM: We have an API token-based SCIM endpoint (scim-prod.northbridge.io). We will provide a temporary token for initial provisioning and a vaulted service account token for production.
- IP allowlist: we cannot provide /8-style wildcards. Our egress is through a set of managed NATs; infra@northbridge.io will send exact CIDR prefixes for the three egress endpoints (expected within 24 hours).
- Service accounts: policy allows non-human service accounts but requires approval from InfoSec and periodic rotation; we will request short-lived tokens and coordinate rotation cadence.

Attachments: I’ve uploaded the sample user CSV and our internal SCIM schema to the Drive folder you shared.

Scheduling: Wed 11/3 09:00 PT works for the 30-min kickoff. Infra will join and provide the egress list during the call.

Aisha
Head of Platform Security | Northbridge Financial
